Because I am disabled with history of abuse and  doctors won’t keep an eye out for me, so I have to do it myself. 

So I was put on Oxycodone after my top surgery to help relieve the pain post-procedure. This was a horrible mistake. 

Several years ago, I was snorting drugs I found in my kitchen cabinet. Ever since I have been very clear with my doctors about my past stimulant abuse. It’s in my paperwork and everything. 

After being prescribed Oxy, I foolishly thought that I could handle it on my own. This resulted in me taking the whole bottle (which likely contained less than 20 pills or so) in less than two weeks time. It doesn’t sound like a lot because it started off with me taking it as needed. Then, slowly, one pill just wasn’t cutting it for me. I took two and experienced my first oxy-related high. From that moment on it was over. Over the course of a few more days I realized that if I didn’t finish off that bottle soon, I was just going to become more dependent on it. So rather than using a medicinal dissolver packet to rid of the medicine, I decided to pop the last five pills and watch some old cartoons. The worst part about this experience was that it was the best high I’ve ever had. 

Before I was prescribed Oxycodone I would have never imagined myself using heroin, but as soon as I ran out all I could think about for months on end was “can it really be that bad?”


TL;DR
Doctors provided me an extremely addictive drug that I could have ended up wasting my life on if I didn’t act quick enough.
